dedupe_keys.name: geoclimate urban morphology and climate input toolbox

description: GeoClimate is an OrbisGIS toolbox developed by the DECIDE GIS team at Lab-STICC to prepare geographic inputs for environmental and climate studies. It derives urban morphology indicators, sky-view factors and Local Climate Zones from vector layers. Documented workflows use OpenStreetMap or the French BD TOPO database, while other vector sources can be connected. Its Groovy code runs with Java through a command-line interface and JSON configurations. Coverage and spatial units follow the supplied territory and input-data vintage; it does not supply a uniform global historical series. Current releases also prepare indicators for urban climate models such as TARGET. The repository is free under LGPL-3.0; the older 0.0.1 Zenodo metadata instead states CC BY 4.0, so users should check the selected release. A limitation is sensitivity to missing or inaccurate building attributes, especially height. The documentation also distinguishes current code from packaged releases. Existing data-openstreetmap is an input source. This review checked metadata and documentation without running geographic processing.
